# Google Material Icons asset provenance

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
- Pinned commit: `abd7f5c0e179c83f068c770650bd14ebac5d5a09`
- Icon family/style: classic Material Icons, filled `materialicons`, 24 px source artwork
- License: Apache License 2.0; full upstream text is preserved in
  `licenses/google-material-icons-Apache-2.0.txt`.

| Quader asset | Exact upstream path at the pinned commit |
| --- | --- |
| `resources/icons/material_visibility.svg` | `src/action/visibility/materialicons/24px.svg` |
| `resources/icons/material_visibility_off.svg` | `src/action/visibility_off/materialicons/24px.svg` |
| `resources/icons/material_lock.svg` | `src/action/lock/materialicons/24px.svg` |
| `resources/icons/material_lock_open.svg` | `src/action/lock_open/materialicons/24px.svg` |
| `resources/icons/material_visibility.png` | `png/action/visibility/materialicons/48dp/2x/baseline_visibility_black_48dp.png` |
| `resources/icons/material_visibility_off.png` | `png/action/visibility_off/materialicons/48dp/2x/baseline_visibility_off_black_48dp.png` |
| `resources/icons/material_lock.png` | `png/action/lock/materialicons/48dp/2x/baseline_lock_black_48dp.png` |
| `resources/icons/material_lock_open.png` | `png/action/lock_open/materialicons/48dp/2x/baseline_lock_open_black_48dp.png` |

The SVG path data and 24-by-24 view boxes are preserved verbatim from the
upstream files. The runtime PNGs are Google's official transparent 48dp@2x
exports and therefore have 96-by-96 pixel dimensions. Only the destination
filenames differ.
